mechanism: Thiazide diuretics can cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia, which increase sensitivity to sympathomimetic effects and may potentiate hypertensive crisis risk with MAOIs; tranylcypromine inhibits monoamine oxidase leading to increased norepinephrine levels that can be exacerbated by chlorthalidone-induced electrolyte depletion.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, maintain electrolytes (especially potassium and sodium) within normal range, consider alternative antihypertensive agent with MAOI therapy, and counsel patient on dietary sodium/potassium management.
